title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability | Cloudflare Blog
body:
5 minute read

Today, Calif.io, Wiz, OpenAI and Quarkslab disclosed twovulnerabilities in PHP, tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 and known as php2shell. The vulnerabilities affect all web servers running PHP 5.4 or later and they may allow an attacker to cause denial of service, remote code execution, and data exposure when an application processes specially crafted HTTP traffic. [...] | CVE-2026-109619 | A fatal error interrupts a request, leaving PHP holding references to memory that is released when the request ends. When the same PHP process handles a later request, it may follow those outdated references and access memory that is no longer valid and expose sensitive data. | [...] |  |  |
 --- |
| Vulnerability | What goes wrong |
| CVE-2026-109618 | PHP runs out of memory and interrupts its work before some internal data has been properly initialized. During cleanup of that request, PHP may use this unfinished data as though it were valid. |

title: Install critical PHP safety update or go offline, cyber chiefs tell websites
body:
# Cyber chiefs tell websites to make critical safety update or go offline

Getty Images Hands on a computer keyboard

Organisations which rely on the PHP programming language are being told they should install a significant software update today - or consider taking their websites offline.

Two critical vulnerabilities with PHP, which is widely used across the internet, have been identified.

The PHP Foundation, which supports it, is issuing updates which address them on Wednesday afternoon. [...] The UK's National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), as well as its counterparts in the EU and Australia have urged those who use PHP to apply the fixes as soon as they become available.

The Netherlands' cyber-security agency says it is taking its own website offline due to the vulnerabilities identified.

The country's National Institute for Public Health and the Environment, an agency of the Dutch government, has taken down its website. [...] "PHP is everywhere. It ​quietly powers WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, and Magento sites, shared hosting platforms, control panels, and an awful ⁠lot of software that doesn't even advertise that it runs PHP under the hood," cybersecurity company Huntress said.

The European Union Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-EU) said the risk scores given to the vulnerabilities "indicate the potential for unauthenticated remote code execution".

title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics becomes NVIDIA’s “AI chip buddy,” builds dedicated production line in South Korea - First-Class Business Newspaper Financial News
body: [Financial News] Samsung Electro-Mechanics is joining forces with NVIDIA, a leader in the global AI semiconductor market, to build a production line in South Korea dedicated to AI semiconductor package substrates. The two companies will jointly invest to expand production capacity at their Sejong and Busan sites and establish a multi-year, long-term supply arrangement covering substrates for both AI accelerators and data-center networks. The move is expected to strengthen Samsung [...] NVIDIA will secure a stable supply chain in advance for the cutting-edge substrates essential to mass-producing AI semiconductors, helping ease bottlenecks in the supply of global AI infrastructure. Samsung Electro-Mechanics, meanwhile, will step up its high-value-added AI semiconductor package substrate business, where technological barriers to entry are the highest, and strengthen its position in the global market. [...] next-generation AI infrastructure. Under the agreement, the two companies will jointly invest to expand facilities for producing AI semiconductor package substrates. Samsung Electro-Mechanics plans to supply NVIDIA with package substrates for AI semiconductors on a long-term basis over multiple years.

title: Nvidia taps Korean component makers for AI chips, robots - The Korea Herald
body:
Samsung Electro-Mechanics and LG Innotek are expanding their ties with Nvidia, applying their expertise in semiconductor substrates and sensing technology to the US chipmaker's growing AI computing and robotics businesses.

Samsung Electro-Mechanics announced a multiyear agreement Wednesday to supply advanced semiconductor substrates for Nvidia's AI processors and networking chips, while LG Innotek said Thursday it was working with Nvidia to develop sensing systems for humanoid robots. [...] Samsung Electro-Mechanics and Nvidia announced a multiyear agreement Wednesday to expand semiconductor substrate production in South Korea for the US chipmaker's AI processors and networking chips. (Samsung Electro-Mechanics) 

Samsung Electro-Mechanics and Nvidia announced a multiyear agreement Wednesday to expand semiconductor substrate production in South Korea for the US chipmaker's AI processors and networking chips. (Samsung Electro-Mechanics) [...] The substrates will be used in AI computing processors and high-speed networking chips for data centers. They provide electrical connections between semiconductor chips and circuit boards, making them essential to high-performance computing systems.

Samsung Electro-Mechanics will initially supply Nvidia through its existing Korean manufacturing operations, with additional capacity planned through factory upgrades and new facilities.

title: Nvidia turns OpenShell into a full hardware stack for safe AI agents
body:
Nvidia has released a design for running AI agents inside fixed limits, from enterprise infrastructure to edge machines. Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, Microsoft, Google Cloud and AWS are among the companies working with it, Nvidia said.

Nvidia announced the OpenShell Reference Architecture at its GTC Berlin conference on Wednesday. It is available now. Last week, Nvidia set out plans for $2B in European deals.

## How it works [...] Agents from Anthropic, Cohere, Google, Meta, OpenAI, Perplexity, Reflection and SpaceX Super Intelligence can run on OpenShell infrastructure, Nvidia said. Security companies including 1Password, Check Point, CrowdStrike, Cisco, Fortinet, Okta, Palo Alto Networks and Zscaler are adding support for it. [...] On stage, Huang pointed to Nvidia’s partnership with Anthropic. Since September, Anthropic has paired Claude Managed Agents, its service for running Claude agents, with OpenShell, so companies can limit what Claude agents do and log every action, Anthropic said at the time.
